title: Eagle 2: Building Post-Training Data Strategies from Scratch for Frontier Vision-Language Models

title: Problem
问题
html:
Frontier VLM reports rarely disclose how raw multimodal sources are selected, reformatted, balanced, and filtered into a competitive post-training mixture.

Eagle 2 studies each data strategy from scratch and releases the resulting capability-labeled conversation mixture with per-source licensing metadata. The decision boundary is whether a serialized training record survives data-source quality studies, deduplication, task balancing, and fixed-model ablations; the central artifact is data consumed by frontier VLM post-training SFT, not a model-only release.

L4 facts: primary source arXiv:2501.14818; arXiv preprint; data object Llama-Nemotron-VLM-Dataset-v1 with millions of post-training conversations, including 1.92M VQA, 814K OCR, and 132K captioning records; evaluation surface Eagle2-9B matches or exceeds several compared VLMs with up to 70B parameters across the reported multimodal benchmark suite, supporting the data-centric recipe rather than parameter scale alone.; collection note: full paper, official README, license, schema, and an actual public record checked on 2026-07-27.

前沿视觉语言报告很少披露如何把原始多模态来源筛选、改写、配比并过滤为有竞争力的后训练混合。

Eagle 2 从头研究每个数据决策，并公开按能力组织且带逐来源许可信息的对话混合。 判定边界是记录能否通过来源质量研究、去重、任务配比和固定模型消融并成为前沿视觉语言模型的后训练监督微调的输入；中心产物是训练数据，而不是只发布模型。

L4 事实：主要来源为 arXiv:2501.14818；来源状态为arXiv 预印本；数据对象是 Llama-Nemotron-VLM-Dataset-v1，规模为数百万条后训练对话，其中包括 192 万条视觉问答、81.4 万条文字识别和 13.2 万条图像描述记录；评估锚点为论文中的 9B 模型在多模态评测组上达到或超过若干最高 70B 的对比模型，说明数据配方而非单凭参数规模是关键因素。；已于 2026-07-27 阅读全文、官方说明、许可、字段和一条公开实际记录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Eagle 2 studies each data strategy from scratch and releases the resulting capability-labeled conversation mixture with per-source licensing metadata. Relative to post-training mixtures disclosed only as aggregate names or final checkpoints, it makes record id, image, conversation turns, and provenance metadata the reusable target and uses data-source quality studies, deduplication, task balancing, and fixed-model ablations as the feedback contract, so Track 01 is the correct category.

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 - Source the task substrate. Input: public vision-language datasets audited and regrouped by capability. Operation: Normalize prompts, media, provenance, and reference fields into candidate records. Output and transition: Auditable candidates advance to target generation. Check / stop rule: Reject missing task inputs, source identifiers, or access terms.

Step 2 - Write the reusable target. Input: Each normalized candidate and its source evidence. Operation: source labels and synthetic conversations are reformatted and selectively rewritten. Output and transition: A serialized response, reasoning trace, or tool trajectory advances to verification. Check / stop rule: Stop when the target cannot be linked to the prompt, teacher, or source evidence.

Step 3 - Verify and package. Input: Generated targets and the paper's correctness metadata. Operation: Apply data-source quality studies, deduplication, task balancing, and fixed-model ablations. Output and transition: Passing records form millions of post-training conversations, including 1.92M VQA, 814K OCR, and 132K captioning records stored as Parquet conversation records with image assets. Check / stop rule: Reject failures; do not treat final-answer agreement as proof that every intermediate step is correct.

Step 4 - Train and evaluate the consumer. Input: The versioned release and the paper's base checkpoint. Operation: Use the records for frontier VLM post-training SFT and compare with post-training mixtures disclosed only as aggregate names or final checkpoints. Output and transition: A trained consumer and the controlled evidence reported by the paper. Check / stop rule: Pin data, teacher, tools, prompts, model, and harness; stop claims at the evaluated domains.

Reproducibility requires the official data revision, generation settings, verifier/tool versions, random seeds, split, base model, and evaluation harness. Unreported budgets remain unknown.

步骤 1——取得任务底材。 输入：按能力重新审计和组织的公开视觉语言数据。 操作：统一题目、媒体、来源和参考字段，形成候选记录。 输出及流转：可审计候选进入目标生成阶段。 检查与停止规则：缺少任务输入、来源标识或使用条款时拒绝。

步骤 2——写入可复用目标。 输入：标准化候选及其来源证据。 操作：来源答案与合成对话被统一格式并选择性改写。 输出及流转：序列化回答、推理过程或工具轨迹进入验证阶段。 检查与停止规则：目标无法对应题目、生成者或来源证据时停止。

步骤 3——验证并打包。 输入：生成目标和论文定义的正确性信息。 操作：执行来源质量研究、去重、任务配比和固定模型消融。 输出及流转：通过的记录组成官方发布并按数据页格式保存。 检查与停止规则：失败记录被拒绝；最终答案一致不代表每个中间步骤正确。

步骤 4——训练并评估消费者。 输入：固定版本的数据与论文基础模型。 操作：用于前沿视觉语言模型的后训练监督微调，并与最近基线比较。 输出及流转：训练后的消费者和论文报告的受控证据。 检查与停止规则：固定数据、教师、工具、提示、模型和评测器，结论不越过已评估领域。

复现还需固定数据版本、生成设置、验证器或工具版本、随机种子、切分、基础模型和评测器；未披露预算保持未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Experiment 1: Eagle2-9B matches or exceeds several compared VLMs with up to 70B parameters across the reported multimodal benchmark suite, supporting the data-centric recipe rather than parameter scale alone.

Experiment 2: The released artifact contains millions of post-training conversations, including 1.92M VQA, 814K OCR, and 132K captioning records; on 2026-07-27 the official Hub page exposed an actual record with fields record id, image, conversation turns, and provenance metadata and reported 1841 downloads. Artifact use does not by itself validate the paper's causal claim.

实验 1：论文中的 9B 模型在多模态评测组上达到或超过若干最高 70B 的对比模型，说明数据配方而非单凭参数规模是关键因素。

实验 2：官方发布规模为数百万条后训练对话，其中包括 192 万条视觉问答、81.4 万条文字识别和 13.2 万条图像描述记录。2026-07-27 的数据页可读取含记录编号、图像、多轮对话和来源元数据的实际记录并显示 1841 次下载；使用量不能代替因果实验。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The closest prior baseline is post-training mixtures disclosed only as aggregate names or final checkpoints. The paper changes the reusable object by making record id, image, conversation turns, and provenance metadata explicit and coupling it to data-source quality studies, deduplication, task balancing, and fixed-model ablations. This is a direction signal because another team can train the stated consumer from the released records. The inherited backbone, source tasks, autoregressive objective, and public benchmarks are not new.
最近基线是只披露数据集总称或最终检查点的后训练混合。真正变化是把记录编号、图像、多轮对话和来源元数据显式化，并与来源质量研究、去重、任务配比和固定模型消融绑定。另一团队可以直接用公开记录训练所述消费者，因此这是数据方向信号。继承的骨干、来源任务、自回归目标和公开基准并不新。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. source-level licensing and contamination remain heterogeneous.
  2. The published checks do not establish that every intermediate reasoning step is correct or causally necessary.
  3. Reuse must preserve CC-BY-4.0 at the aggregate release; component terms are listed per source and any upstream media or source-data terms.

1. 逐来源许可和污染情况仍不一致；以基准表现驱动来源选择也可能过度拟合公开评测组。
  2. 已公开检查不能证明每个中间推理步骤都正确或不可替代。
  3. 复用必须保留官方许可，并继续遵守所有上游媒体或来源数据条款。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• Use the dataset to build or ablate frontier VLM post-training SFT; preserve provenance and compare a fixed backbone before attributing gains to the traces.
  • Audit a stratified sample against data-source quality studies, deduplication, task balancing, and fixed-model ablations. The output should be a versioned keep/reject ledger, not only a benchmark score.

• 可用该数据构建或消融前沿视觉语言模型的后训练监督微调；保留来源并固定骨干后，才能把收益归因于轨迹。
  • 按来源和难度分层抽样，依据来源质量研究、去重、任务配比和固定模型消融复核。输出应是带版本的保留与拒绝台账，而不只是基准分数。

  • 复用决定：适合前沿视觉语言模型的后训练监督微调；首先审计中间步骤、来源和许可。
